title: People
subtitle: Console accounts, directory sign-in and the roles they hold.

typeTitle.ldap: Signs in with a directory account
typeTitle.internal: Local account with its own password
typeTitle.api_service: Service account for the external API

table.emptyBody: Add the first user to give someone access to the console.
table.noMatchBody: Try another search or clear the type filter.

row.deleteSuperadmin: The superadmin account cannot be deleted
row.deleteSelf: You cannot delete the account you are signed in with

legend.title: Roles
legend.subtitle: What each role can reach in the console.

roleDesc.superadmin: Everything, including People. The only role that manages console users. Cannot be deleted.
roleDesc.admin: Every area except People: calls, archive, contact centre, extensions, health and connections.
roleDesc.cc-admin: Contact-centre administration: agents, campaigns (optionally scoped) and the node monitor, plus Core Cluster calls.
roleDesc.tel-admin: Telephony administration with access to Edge PBX call records.
roleDesc.cc-operator: Searches and plays Core Cluster call records.
roleDesc.tel-operator: Searches and plays Edge PBX call records.
roleDesc.it-support: Reserves and creates Edge PBX extensions and browses the extension directory.
roleDesc.user: Read-only access to call records from both sources.
roleDesc.api_service: A service identity for integrations. Signs in to the external API only, never to the console.

create.title: Add a console user
create.description: Give a colleague or a service access to Bani.
create.apiNote: API accounts are always local service identities, so the user type is fixed.

directory.emptyBody: Try a different name or username.
directory.pick: Pick a person from the directory

access.label: Access mode
access.directHint: The role you choose here applies.
access.groupHint: The role follows the group mapping.
access.warningTitle: Roles come from the group mapping
access.warning: With group access the role is set by the directory groups mapped below. The role chosen here is only a fallback.

field.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, or generate one.
